The live web data engine for teams and agents.
Website  ·  Docs  ·  Pricing  ·  MCP Registry
One platform to build, search, extract, enrich, map, and monitor data across the entire web.
Ask for any dataset in plain words, and SpecStream builds it from the entire live web: every match f
ound, extracted and enriched into structured records, then monitored for change. It runs through the
API and MCP, and inside Sheets, CRMs, Slack, n8n, Zapier and the other tools teams already use.
| Product | What it does | Price |
| Search API | `GET /v1/web-search`. The most accurate web search API in the world (scores and metho

d). Answers a question from the live web in seconds. | $5 per 1,000 searches |
| Extract API | `POST
/v1/extract`. The main text of up to 20 web pages, PDF, Word or Excel files a call. The MCP tool is

`read_pages`. | $0.80 per 1,000 pages. A page with no text is not charged. |
| Deep Search | Ask in
plain words. Get every match on the live web, in structured rows. It also enriches a list you have
and monitors for change. | 5¢, 15¢ or $1 a row |

## What the agent does in Deep Search, in order
Nothing is spent until a person, or an agent inside a limit a person set, approves a price.
1. `compile` reads the request and returns how SpecStream understood it: the kind of thing, the cond

itions every result must meet, the facts to bring back.
2. `quote_capacity_work` returns the price a

nd the most the work can cost. A price lasts 30 minutes.
3. `authorize_capacity_work` approves that
exact quote, with the maximum in cents (`confirm_max_cents`) and a stable `idempotency_key`, so a re

try never pays twice.
4. `get_find` shows progress while rows arrive. `list_find_rows` returns resul

ts with the reason and the source for each fact.
5. `export_find`, `share_find`, and `send_to_destin
ation` move results on. Reading, exporting, and sharing cost nothing.
Each delivered row costs 5 cents, 15 cents or $1 depending on how much it needs, plus 5 cents for a
person's email and 15 cents for a phone. A run that finds nothing costs nothing. See pricing.
Four skills in `skills/` teach an agent this order and where to stop and ask: `compile`, `review-wor
k`, `approve-work`, `continue-work`.
The Search API and Extract API are one call each, `search_web` and `read_pages` on MCP. The `search-
web` and `extract-pages` skills teach them.
## What comes back
The Search API returns the answer, its rows and the search results it read. The Extract API returns
each page's main text, title and published date.
Deep Search returns structured rows for any kind of record: companies, local businesses, grants, ten
ders, clinical trials, papers, datasets, regulations, vulnerabilities, apps, repositories, packages,
podcasts and books. Each condition you wrote is checked against the result's own words and numbers,
and a row that fails is not delivered. Facts from many sites join into one record.
SpecStream reads registries and official APIs, maps and directories, job boards, research indexes, n
ews and each result's own site at the moment you ask.
